-- ============================================================
-- EX 603 reference dataset: Social Media / Content Platform
-- Generated deterministically (seed 603). Do not edit by hand.
-- Load with:  createdb ex603_social && psql -d ex603_social -f social.sql
-- ============================================================
-- PostgreSQL load:  createdb ex603_social  &&  psql -d ex603_social -f social.sql
-- (Re-running is safe: every table is dropped first, children before parents.)
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS likes CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS post_hashtags CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS post_media CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS hashtags CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS posts CASCADE;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS users CASCADE;

-- ---------- actor ----------
CREATE TABLE users (
    user_id        INT           NOT NULL,
    user_name      VARCHAR(120)  NOT NULL,
    signup_date      DATE          NOT NULL,
    country    VARCHAR(80)   NOT NULL,
    email    VARCHAR(160)  NOT NULL,
    invited_by INT           NULL,
    is_active      BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_users_email UNIQUE (email),
    CONSTRAINT ck_users_no_self CHECK (invited_by IS NULL OR invited_by <> user_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_users_ref FOREIGN KEY (invited_by)
        REFERENCES users (user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

-- ---------- producer ----------
CREATE TABLE posts (
    post_id        INT           NOT NULL,
    post_title      VARCHAR(120)  NOT NULL,
    posted_on      DATE          NOT NULL,
    author_country    VARCHAR(80)   NOT NULL,
    slug    VARCHAR(60)   NOT NULL,
    like_count    INT NOT NULL,
    is_visible      BOOLEAN       NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    PRIMARY KEY (post_id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_posts_slug UNIQUE (slug),
    CONSTRAINT ck_posts_metric CHECK (like_count >= 0)
);

-- ---------- multivalued attribute, resolved ----------
CREATE TABLE post_media (
    post_id   INT       NOT NULL,
    media_code  CHAR(2) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (post_id, media_code),
    CONSTRAINT fk_post_media_owner FOREIGN KEY (post_id)
        REFERENCES posts (post_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- ---------- catalog ----------
CREATE TABLE hashtags (
    hashtag_id    INT          NOT NULL,
    hashtag_name  VARCHAR(60)  NOT NULL,
    hashtag_description  VARCHAR(200) NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (hashtag_id),
    CONSTRAINT uq_hashtags_name UNIQUE (hashtag_name)
);

-- ---------- junction: producer to catalog, composite PK ----------
CREATE TABLE post_hashtags (
    post_id   INT  NOT NULL,
    hashtag_id   INT  NOT NULL,
    tagged_on DATE NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (post_id, hashtag_id),
    CONSTRAINT fk_post_hashtags_prod FOREIGN KEY (post_id)
        REFERENCES posts (post_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT fk_post_hashtags_cat FOREIGN KEY (hashtag_id)
        REFERENCES hashtags (hashtag_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);

-- ---------- event: the high volume fact table ----------
CREATE TABLE likes (
    like_id       BIGINT        NOT NULL,
    user_id       INT           NOT NULL,
    post_id       INT           NOT NULL,
    liked_at       TIMESTAMP      NOT NULL,
    unliked_at      TIMESTAMP      NULL,
    client_country   VARCHAR(80)   NOT NULL,
    dwell_ms   DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,
    scroll_depth   DECIMAL(7,2) NOT NULL,
    weight    DECIMAL(4,2)  NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.00,
    reaction_status   VARCHAR(20)   NOT NULL,
    removal_reason   VARCHAR(60)   NULL,     -- nullable by design
    PRIMARY KEY (like_id),
    CONSTRAINT ck_likes_metric_pos  CHECK (dwell_ms >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_likes_second_pos  CHECK (scroll_depth > 0),
    CONSTRAINT ck_likes_third_min   CHECK (weight >= 1.00),
    CONSTRAINT ck_likes_time_order  CHECK (unliked_at IS NULL OR unliked_at >= liked_at),
    CONSTRAINT fk_likes_actor FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES users (user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
    CONSTRAINT fk_likes_prod FOREIGN KEY (post_id)
        REFERENCES posts (post_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
